policy: Every entry is code that exists only to read or convert names Stave no longer uses, or to replay a rename on another branch. `bun run check:temporary-migrations` fails once package.json reaches removeInVersion; delete the marked blocks, the listed tests and the entry before that release. See AGENTS.md, Temporary Migrations.

migrations.description: Remove the unused message FTS table and scan index when opening a profile created by the initial content search implementation. Derived documents and the task vocabulary remain supported.

Turn file snapshots replaced the per-task HEAD checkpoint after 0.35.0. Store rehydration deletes the saved taskCheckpointById map, which is no longer written. At expiry, delete the marked block and the listed test; a profile that skipped these releases keeps an unused key that nothing reads.

Tars schedules were removed after 0.35.2. Opening the Tars conversation retires the schedule actions saved replies carry: each becomes a `retired` position and its receipt is deleted; the reply's words and its other actions stay where they were, so an interrupted reply resumes on the receipts it already had. The action left the conversation contract, so a reply that kept one could not be read and the whole conversation would fail to load. It runs once per profile: the conversion creates the empty marker table tars_schedule_actions_retired in its own transaction, and later opens only look that table up. At expiry, delete the marked blocks and the listed test; a profile that skipped these releases and has such a reply cannot open its Tars conversation. The `retired` position stays in the conversation contract (converted replies carry it), as do the marker table and the tars_schedules, tars_schedule_requests and tars_schedule_runs tables, which nothing reads.
